renderer_measurement.method: Single instrumented call per depth and implementation; tracemalloc started after constructing nested SliceType nodes; recursion limit 100; elapsed wall seconds; output checked against [] repeated depth times plus i32.
renderer_measurement.measurement_script:
import sys,time,tracemalloc,json,pathlib,types
import a7.types as t
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/a7-renderer-cost-evidence');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
label=sys.argv[1]
if label=='before':(out/'before-types.py').write_text(pathlib.Path('a7/types.py').read_text())
records=[]
for depth in [1500,5000]:
 node=t.I32
 for _ in range(depth):node=t.SliceType(node)
 previous=sys.getrecursionlimit();sys.setrecursionlimit(100)
 try:
  tracemalloc.start();started=time.perf_counter();text=str(node);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started;_,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
 finally:sys.setrecursionlimit(previous)
 assert text=='[]'*depth+'i32'
 records.append(dict(depth=depth,seconds=elapsed,peak_traced_bytes=peak,output_length=len(text)))
(out/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2));print(label,json.dumps(records))
